title: Drop it anywhere: localization without tags
note: The K1 is dropped at a random spot facing a random way. It spins once, matches its depth slice against the iPhone floor plan, lets Gemma's landmark sightings break ties between look-alike rooms, then walks to a random destination with drift correction every second. Depth is deliberately degraded (15% dropouts, 10% clutter hits). When unsure it asks the guest which room they're in.
say: Drop it anywhere. It looks around, works out where it is from the map we scanned, and if it isn't sure, it simply asks you.
